title: Teach Small Models to Reason by Curriculum Distillation
authors_zh: Wangyi Jiang、Yaojie Lu、Hongyu Lin、Xianpei Han、Le Sun
paper_type_zh: 难度感知的课程蒸馏数据构建方案
best_for_zh: 研究小模型推理蒸馏、教师轨迹筛选与课程数据审计的读者
one_line: Curriculum Distillation filters a 6,445-problem matched teacher pool with Math-Verify and changes trace style across two difficulty-aware SFT stages, but releases neither the pool nor its construction artifacts.
该工作以 Math-Verify 筛得 6,445 道题的匹配教师池，并按难度在两阶段 SFT 中切换轨迹类型，但未发布语料与构建产物。
why: It turns teacher mode, answer verification, difficulty, and training order into explicit data-construction variables; the unreleased examples, indices, prompts, and lineage keep it at recipe/audit-reference status rather than a reusable data release.
inclusion_reason: A concrete two-stage reasoning-data construction recipe that conditions teacher identity and trace style on both MATH difficulty and curriculum stage, with an explicit final-answer intersection filter and measurable single-stage controls.

title: Problem
问题
html:
The official EMNLP 2025 paper asks why direct reasoning distillation into 3B students underperforms even when the teacher is stronger. Long Think traces from DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B can be too complex for a small student to imitate, while its compressed NoThink answers can omit the procedural scaffolding that makes general mathematical reasoning learnable. The decision problem is therefore not merely which teacher is strongest, but which teacher response mode should supervise each difficulty band and at what point in training. (Paper Sections 1 and 4.1, pp. 7412-7417.)

The constructed object begins with the 7,500 MATH training problems and their five difficulty levels. For each problem, the authors seek correct Instruct, Think, NoRethink, and NoThink responses from two 32B teachers, retain the Think response's condensed solution as another target, and use the surviving problems to assemble two stage-specific SFT mixtures. This is a data-construction/open-release-track entry because teacher identity, trace form, final-answer filtering, difficulty, and curriculum order are all construction variables; it is not evidence that long reasoning is intrinsically faithful or that the unreleased corpus is safe to reuse.

The Card reaches the paper's L4 evidence boundary through the official proceedings PDF, DOI, BibTeX, affiliations, and Responsible NLP Checklist. That boundary stops short of reusable artifacts: no appendix, generated dataset, code, retained-index manifest, project page, or student checkpoint is supplied by the verified official materials.

EMNLP 2025 正式论文研究一个具体问题：即使教师更强，直接把推理蒸馏给 3B 学生模型仍可能效果不佳。DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 的长 Think 轨迹可能复杂到小模型难以模仿，而压缩后的 NoThink 解答又可能缺少支持一般数学推理的过程脚手架。因此，关键决策不只是选择最强教师，而是让哪种教师回答模式监督哪个难度区间，以及把这种监督放在训练的哪个阶段。（论文第 1、4.1 节，第 7412-7417 页。）

构造对象从 MATH 训练集的 7,500 道题及其五级难度标签开始。作者为每道题从两个 32B 教师获取正确的 Instruct、Think、NoRethink 与 NoThink 回答，另保留 Think 回答中的压缩最终解答，再用通过筛选的题目组装两个阶段各自的 SFT 混合。本工作属于“数据构造与开放发布”轨道，因为教师身份、轨迹形式、最终答案筛选、难度和课程顺序都是构造变量；它并不能证明长推理本身忠实，也不能证明未发布语料可以安全复用。

本卡的 L4 证据边界来自正式会议论文、DOI、BibTeX、作者机构与 Responsible NLP Checklist。可复用性证据则止于此：经核验的官方材料没有附录、生成数据集、代码、保留索引清单、项目页或学生模型检查点。

title: Core idea
核心思路
html:
The contribution is a difficulty- and stage-conditioned distillation schedule over a matched set of teacher outputs. Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct supplies ordinary chain-of-thought solutions. DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B is elicited in three modes: Think retains full deliberation; NoRethink suppresses a small set of self-correction trigger words to encourage a more linear trace; NoThink prepends a trivial completed-thought template so the model proceeds directly to a solution. These are observable prompting/decoding conditions, not verified internal cognitive states. (Paper Section 3.1.1.)

Math-Verify supplies the feedback contract. Within up to four samples per problem and condition, it accepts an extracted final answer; a problem enters the 6,445-item pool only if Instruct, Think, NoRethink, and NoThink each yield at least one accepted solution. The verifier can observe answer equivalence after extraction, but it cannot certify the logical validity or faithfulness of intermediate text. Thus the process text receives SFT supervision, while selection remains answer-level.

Stage 1 uses Instruct traces for MATH Levels 1-4 and NoThink solutions for Level 5. Stage 2 changes Levels 1-4 to NoThink and Level 5 to NoRethink. The closest paper baseline, Mix-Long from Li et al. (2025), randomly mixes Instruct and Think outputs at 4:1. The essential change is to replace a static random long/short mixture with a curriculum indexed jointly by problem difficulty and training stage. (Paper Section 4.2 and Table 2.)

本文贡献是一套建立在匹配教师输出之上的、同时受难度和训练阶段控制的蒸馏日程。Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 提供普通 chain-of-thought 解答；DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 则以三种模式生成：Think 保留完整审慎推理，NoRethink 禁止少量会触发自我修正的词以促成更线性的轨迹，NoThink 在开头加入无信息的“已经思考完毕”模板，使模型直接给出解答。这些是可观察的提示与解码条件，并不是经验证的内部认知状态。（论文第 3.1.1 节。）

反馈合同由 Math-Verify 提供。在每道题、每种条件最多四次采样的预算内，它接受经抽取的最终答案；只有 Instruct、Think、NoRethink 和 NoThink 都至少产生一个被接受解答的题目，才进入含 6,445 道题的池。该验证器能观察答案抽取后的等价性，却不能证明中间文本在逻辑上正确或忠实。因此，过程文本在 SFT 中受到监督，而样本选择仍是答案级的。

阶段 1 对 MATH Levels 1-4 使用 Instruct 轨迹，对 Level 5 使用 NoThink 解答；阶段 2 把 Levels 1-4 改为 NoThink，把 Level 5 改为 NoRethink。论文中最接近的基线是 Li et al. (2025) 的 Mix-Long，它按 4:1 随机混合 Instruct 与 Think 输出。关键变化是用同时依赖题目难度和训练阶段的课程，替代固定的长短轨迹随机混合。（论文第 4.2 节与表 2。）

title: Method
方法
html:
The reconstructable pipeline is:

  1. Input pool. Take all 7,500 MATH training problems with Levels 1-5. The paper reports that Level 5 is about 24% of the pool.
  2. Multi-mode generation. Query Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct in Instruct mode and DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B in Think, NoRethink, and NoThink modes. Generation uses temperature 0.6, top-p 0.95, a 16,384-token maximum sequence length, and up to four attempts per problem and condition. The Think response's condensed final solution is retained for a separate single-stage comparison.
  3. Verification and intersection selection. Apply Math-Verify to final answers. Keep a problem only when all four conditions have at least one correct sample. This leaves 6,445 of 7,500 problems; the paper does not say that failed attempts or verifier outputs are preserved.
  4. Stage 1 assembly and SFT. Pair Levels 1-4 with Instruct outputs and Level 5 with NoThink outputs. Fine-tune Qwen2.5-3B or Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct.
  5. Stage 2 assembly and SFT. Starting from the Stage 1 student, pair Levels 1-4 with NoThink outputs and Level 5 with NoRethink outputs. This is offline supervised fine-tuning; no online reward update or interactive environment is used.

The reported training protocol uses LlamaFactory, two epochs, a cosine learning-rate schedule, and maximum learning rate 1e-5; Section 4.2 says it follows the single-stage protocol but does not separately tabulate stage-specific steps. Evaluation uses the same temperature, top-p, and 16,384-token cap, with 32 samples per AIME/AMC problem and 8 per MATH-500, Minerva, and OlympiadBench problem; results are reported as Pass@1. (Paper Sections 4.1-4.2.)

A faithful reproduction must additionally pin the exact teacher/student checkpoint revisions, complete prompts and answer extractor, random seeds, retained MATH indices, per-attempt verifier records, the two curriculum manifests, hardware, and stage-specific optimization steps. None of these artifacts is released. The official checklist marks computational budget/infrastructure as reported, but the proceedings text does not identify hardware or GPU hours.

可重建的流程如下：

  1. 输入池。 使用 MATH 训练集全部 7,500 道题及 Levels 1-5；论文称 Level 5 约占数据的 24%。
  2. 多模式生成。 让 Qwen2.5-32B-Instruct 以 Instruct 模式生成，让 DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-32B 以 Think、NoRethink 和 NoThink 模式生成。参数为 temperature 0.6、top-p 0.95、最大序列长度 16,384；每道题、每种条件最多尝试四次。另抽取 Think 回答的压缩最终解答，用于单阶段比较。
  3. 验证与交集选择。 使用 Math-Verify 检查最终答案。只有四种条件都至少有一个正确样本的题目才被保留，最终从 7,500 道题中留下 6,445 道；论文没有说明失败尝试或验证器输出是否被保存。
  4. 阶段 1 组装与 SFT。 Levels 1-4 配 Instruct 输出，Level 5 配 NoThink 输出；微调 Qwen2.5-3B 或 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct。
  5. 阶段 2 组装与 SFT。 从阶段 1 学生继续训练，Levels 1-4 配 NoThink 输出，Level 5 配 NoRethink 输出。该过程是离线监督微调，不包含在线奖励更新或交互环境。

论文报告使用 LlamaFactory、两轮训练、余弦学习率日程和最大学习率 1e-5；第 4.2 节称沿用单阶段协议，但没有单独列出各阶段步数。评估沿用相同的 temperature、top-p 与 16,384-token 上限；AIME/AMC 每题采样 32 次，MATH-500、Minerva 和 OlympiadBench 每题采样 8 次，以 Pass@1 报告结果。（论文第 4.1-4.2 节。）

忠实复现还必须固定教师与学生检查点版本、完整提示与答案抽取器、随机种子、保留的 MATH 索引、逐次尝试的验证记录、两个课程清单、硬件和各阶段优化步数；这些产物都未发布。官方 checklist 把计算预算与基础设施标为已报告，但会议正文没有给出硬件或 GPU 小时。

title: Evidence
证据
html:
The mechanism study establishes the motivation but not the training result by itself. In Figure 1, Think has the highest MATH Pass@1 and token use, NoRethink lies between Think and NoThink, and NoThink exceeds its matched Instruct model by as much as 7 percentage points on harder MATH levels with only a small token increase. In the separate context-titration experiment, low-difficulty problems require a median 33% of a successful LRM trace before the Instruct model succeeds, versus 61% for high-difficulty problems. These are author-reported behaviors under the specified Qwen-derived models and sampling protocol. (Paper Figures 1-2, pp. 7415-7416.)

Table 1 shows that direct imitation is not monotonic in teacher reasoning length. For Qwen2.5-3B, the single-stage Instruct dataset averages 26.65 across six benchmarks, compared with 23.39 for NoThink, 21.94 for NoRethink, and 20.08 for Think. The corresponding Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct averages are 26.10, 24.22, 22.06, and 20.82. Thus stronger or longer teacher reasoning does not automatically produce a better student in this setup. (Paper Table 1, p. 7417.)

Table 2 provides the direct curriculum comparison. For Qwen2.5-3B, Stage 1 followed by NoThink+NoRethink Stage 2 scores 6.98 on AIME 2024, 3.44 on AIME 2025, 39.43 on AMC 2023, 64.02 on MATH-500, 26.88 on Minerva, and 29.51 on OlympiadBench, averaging 28.38. The single-stage Instruct baseline averages 26.65 and Mix-Long averages 25.22; Stage 2 alternatives average 27.68 with NoThink only and 27.56 with NoThink+Think. For Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct, the same curriculum averages 27.96 versus 26.10 for single-stage Instruct and 25.85 for Mix-Long. (Paper Table 2, p. 7419.)

These results support a schedule effect under the reported models, data, and evaluation budget. They do not prove that every retained trace is correct, that the difficulty labels are causal, or that the constructed corpus has high data quality. No independent reproduction, corpus release, verifier-error analysis, or ablation that removes the all-mode intersection filter is provided.

机制研究提供了方法动机，但本身不是训练结果。在图 1 中，Think 的 MATH Pass@1 与 token 消耗最高，NoRethink 位于 Think 和 NoThink 之间；在更难的 MATH 级别上，NoThink 最多比匹配的 Instruct 模型高 7 个百分点，而 token 增量很小。在另一项 context-titration 实验中，低难度题需要先提供成功 LRM 轨迹的中位数 33%，Instruct 模型才成功；高难度题则需要 61%。这些都是作者在指定 Qwen 系模型与采样协议下报告的行为。（论文图 1-2，第 7415-7416 页。）

表 1 表明，直接模仿的效果并不随教师推理长度单调提升。对 Qwen2.5-3B，单阶段 Instruct 数据在六个基准上的平均分为 26.65，NoThink、NoRethink 与 Think 分别为 23.39、21.94 和 20.08。对 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，相应平均分为 26.10、24.22、22.06 和 20.82。因此，在该设置中，更强或更长的教师推理不会自动产生更好的学生。（论文表 1，第 7417 页。）

表 2 给出直接的课程比较。对 Qwen2.5-3B，阶段 1 后接 NoThink+NoRethink 阶段 2，在 AIME 2024、AIME 2025、AMC 2023、MATH-500、Minerva 和 OlympiadBench 上分别得到 6.98、3.44、39.43、64.02、26.88 和 29.51，平均 28.38。单阶段 Instruct 平均 26.65，Mix-Long 平均 25.22；阶段 2 改为仅 NoThink 或 NoThink+Think 时，平均分别为 27.68 和 27.56。对 Qwen2.5-3B-Instruct，同一课程平均 27.96，而单阶段 Instruct 与 Mix-Long 分别为 26.10 和 25.85。（论文表 2，第 7419 页。）

这些结果支持在所报告模型、数据与评估预算下存在日程效应，但不能证明每条保留轨迹都正确、难度标签具有因果作用，或构造语料本身具有高质量。论文没有提供独立复现、语料发布、验证器错误分析，也没有消融全模式交集过滤。

title: Novelty
新意
html:
The prior-work baseline is direct or statically mixed teacher-trace distillation. The paper's own single-stage controls train separately on Instruct, NoThink, NoRethink, Think, or the condensed Think solution; Mix-Long randomly combines Instruct and Think outputs at 4:1. Curriculum Distillation changes the selection interface in two ways: every retained prompt has a correct output under all four modes, and the chosen target mode depends on both MATH difficulty and whether training is in Stage 1 or Stage 2.

The direction signal for reasoning-data research is this factorization of the recipe. Teacher capability, response mode, final-answer acceptance, task difficulty, and training order become independently nameable variables rather than one undifferentiated “strong-teacher” dataset. The matched prompt pool also makes mode comparisons less confounded by different prompt sets, although the same intersection rule introduces selection bias toward prompts solvable across all modes.

Teacher distillation, rejection sampling with an answer checker, MATH difficulty labels, and two-stage SFT are not individually new. The paper's concrete contribution is their conditional composition: learnable Instruct traces and dense NoThink solutions establish a foundation, then NoRethink traces externalize reasoning on Level 5. Before reuse, a builder would still need to test whether the fixed Level 5 boundary, prompt-defined modes, and answer-only verifier transfer beyond these Qwen-derived 3B students.

既有基线是直接蒸馏或静态混合教师轨迹。论文内部的单阶段对照分别使用 Instruct、NoThink、NoRethink、Think 或 Think 的压缩最终解答训练；Mix-Long 则按 4:1 随机混合 Instruct 与 Think 输出。Curriculum Distillation 从两方面改变了选择接口：每个保留提示在四种模式下都有正确输出，而且所选目标模式同时取决于 MATH 难度和当前处于阶段 1 还是阶段 2。

它对推理数据研究的方向信号，在于把配方拆成可独立命名的变量：教师能力、回答模式、最终答案接受规则、任务难度与训练顺序，不再被合并成一个笼统的“强教师”数据集。匹配提示池还减少了不同模式使用不同题集造成的混淆；不过，同一交集规则也会引入选择偏差，使数据偏向所有模式都能解出的题目。

教师蒸馏、基于答案检查器的拒绝采样、MATH 难度标签和两阶段 SFT 分别看都不是新组件。论文的具体贡献是按条件组合它们：先用可学习的 Instruct 轨迹和信息密集的 NoThink 解答打基础，再用 NoRethink 轨迹在 Level 5 上外显推理。复用前仍需检验固定的 Level 5 边界、由提示定义的模式和仅看答案的验证器，能否迁移到这些 Qwen 系 3B 学生之外。

title: Limitations
局限
html:
• Answer-only feedback: Math-Verify checks the extracted final answer, not intermediate-step validity or faithfulness. A fluent Think or NoRethink trace can pass with invalid, redundant, or post-hoc reasoning.
  • Intersection-selection bias: Requiring all four conditions to succeed removes 1,055 of 7,500 MATH problems. The reported curriculum is therefore trained on a subset that may be unusually robust across both teachers and all elicitation modes.
  • Prompt-defined modes: NoRethink bans a short keyword list and NoThink injects a completed-thought template. These interventions can change surface wording without cleanly isolating an internal System-1/System-2 mechanism; that interpretation remains an author hypothesis.
  • Missing failures and lineage: The 6,445 retained indices, per-attempt generations, Math-Verify outputs, rejected traces, full prompts, seeds, checkpoint revisions, and curriculum manifests are not released. It is impossible to audit false acceptances, failure retention, or version drift row by row.
  • Release and license gap: No official generated dataset, construction code, project page, or student checkpoint was identified. The paper is CC BY 4.0, but the generated corpus's redistribution terms and the compatibility of its MATH-derived content are not established; the checklist marks the license question not applicable.
  • Reproducibility gap: The main text reports optimizer settings but not hardware, GPU hours, stage-specific steps, or checkpoint selection. This conflicts with the official checklist's “yes” response for computational budget and infrastructure reporting.
  • Narrow scope: The evidence covers English mathematical reasoning, MATH difficulty bands, two Qwen2.5 3B students, and Qwen-derived 32B teachers. Code, general instruction following, multimodal tasks, multilingual settings, other capacities, and learned difficulty measures are untested.
  • Evaluation and attribution: Decontamination or overlap checks for AIME, AMC, MATH-500, Minerva, and OlympiadBench are not reported. Benchmark gains combine the intersection filter, teacher choice, trace mode, curriculum order, and two-stage optimization, so they are not proof of corpus quality or a clean causal estimate of any one component.

• 仅看答案的反馈： Math-Verify 检查抽取后的最终答案，不验证中间步骤的正确性或忠实性。流畅的 Think 或 NoRethink 轨迹仍可能带着无效、冗余或事后补写的推理通过筛选。
  • 交集选择偏差： 要求四种条件都成功，会从 7,500 道 MATH 题中移除 1,055 道。最终课程因此训练在一个可能对两个教师和所有诱导模式都异常稳健的子集上。
  • 由提示定义的模式： NoRethink 禁用一小组关键词，NoThink 注入“已经思考完毕”模板。这些干预可能只改变表面措辞，而不能干净隔离内部的 System-1/System-2 机制；后一解释仍是作者假设。
  • 失败与谱系缺失： 6,445 道保留题的索引、逐次生成、Math-Verify 输出、被拒轨迹、完整提示、随机种子、检查点版本和课程清单均未发布，无法逐行审计误接受、失败保留或版本漂移。
  • 发布与许可缺口： 未核实到官方生成数据集、构建代码、项目页或学生检查点。论文采用 CC BY 4.0，但生成语料的再分发条款及其 MATH 衍生内容的许可兼容性没有建立；checklist 将许可问题标为不适用。
  • 复现缺口： 正文报告了优化器设置，却没有给出硬件、GPU 小时、各阶段步数或检查点选择。这与官方 checklist 对“已报告计算预算与基础设施”的肯定回答不一致。
  • 范围狭窄： 证据仅覆盖英文数学推理、MATH 难度区间、两个 Qwen2.5 3B 学生和 Qwen 系 32B 教师。代码、一般指令遵循、多模态、多语言、其他容量和学习式难度均未测试。
  • 评估与归因： 论文没有报告 AIME、AMC、MATH-500、Minerva 与 OlympiadBench 的去污染或重叠检查。基准增益同时混合了交集过滤、教师选择、轨迹模式、课程顺序与两阶段优化，因此既不能证明语料质量，也不是对任一组件的干净因果估计。

title: Usefulness
用途
html:
Within the data-construction/open-release track, this paper is useful as a recipe and audit reference, not as a directly reusable training release. A builder can reproduce the design by generating several response modes for the same prompts, applying a terminal-answer checker, retaining teacher/mode/attempt/verifier fields, and assigning accepted traces by a predeclared difficulty-by-stage matrix. The first required improvement is to keep failed attempts and verifier diagnostics rather than publishing only selected SFT text.

The work motivates controlled comparisons among fixed curricula, learned or student-conditioned curricula, continuous difficulty measures, and process-aware verification. A strong replication should separate the effect of the all-mode intersection filter from the effect of the two-stage schedule, compare answer-only Math-Verify with step/process checks, and test whether the same mode ordering holds across model sizes and non-math domains.

Reuse class: reading/audit reference only; training reuse is blocked pending release and verification. The paper provides enough detail to implement a hypothesis, but not enough to reconstruct the exact 6,445-row pool. Any future release should pin source indices and checkpoint revisions, serialize all attempts and verifier outputs, publish split/decontamination records and generated-data terms, and report compute by stage.

在“数据构造与开放发布”轨道中，本文适合作为配方和审计参考，而不是可直接复用的训练发布。构建者可以在同一批提示上生成多种回答模式，应用最终答案检查器，保留教师/模式/尝试/验证器字段，再按预先声明的“难度×阶段”矩阵分配通过的轨迹。首要改进是保留失败尝试与验证器诊断，而不是只发布被选中的 SFT 文本。

本文还适合推动固定课程、学习式或学生条件课程、连续难度度量与过程感知验证之间的受控比较。严格复现应把“全模式交集过滤”的影响与“两阶段日程”的影响分开，对比仅看答案的 Math-Verify 和步骤/过程检查，并测试同一模式顺序能否跨模型规模和非数学领域成立。

复用等级：仅作阅读/审计参考；在发布并完成验证前，不应直接用于训练复用。论文细节足以实现一个研究假设，却不足以重建精确的 6,445 题数据池。未来发布应固定源索引与检查点版本，序列化全部尝试和验证器输出，公布切分/去污染记录与生成数据条款，并按阶段报告计算量。

title: Reading notes
阅读笔记
html:
• Read Section 3.1.1 before accepting the System-1/System-2 language: NoRethink and NoThink are concrete elicitation interventions, not direct observations of internal reasoning.
  • In Section 4.1, distinguish the 7,500 source problems, the 6,445 all-mode intersection, up to four attempts per condition, and the unreleased per-attempt records.
  • Read Tables 1 and 2 together: direct Think distillation is the weakest average single-stage condition, while the best two-stage schedule ends with NoRethink only on Level 5.
  • Treat Math-Verify as an answer-level selector; no reported process verifier establishes that the retained reasoning steps are valid or faithful.
  • Cross-check the Limitations section and official checklist: the paper discloses optimizer settings but not hardware/GPU hours, and supplies neither an appendix nor reusable construction artifacts.

• 在接受 System-1/System-2 表述前先读第 3.1.1 节：NoRethink 与 NoThink 是具体诱导干预，不是对内部推理的直接观测。
  • 阅读第 4.1 节时区分 7,500 道源题、6,445 道全模式交集、每种条件最多四次尝试，以及未发布的逐次尝试记录。
  • 联读表 1 与表 2：直接蒸馏 Think 是平均分最低的单阶段条件，而最佳两阶段日程只在 Level 5 的最后阶段使用 NoRethink。
  • 把 Math-Verify 视为答案级选择器；论文没有过程验证器来证明保留的推理步骤正确或忠实。
  • 对照 Limitations 与官方 checklist：论文披露了优化设置，却没有硬件/GPU 小时，也没有附录或可复用构建产物。

items: Math-Verify acceptance establishes final-answer correctness but not intermediate-step validity, faithfulness, or absence of post-hoc rationalization.
Requiring all four conditions to succeed removes 1,055 problems and can select prompts that are unusually easy or robust across teacher behaviors.
NoRethink and NoThink are prompt/decoding interventions, not verified separations of internal reasoning mechanisms.
Only successful selected solutions are described; failed attempts, rejection causes, and counterfactual traces are not released.
The curriculum depends on MATH's five difficulty labels, English mathematical tasks, Qwen-derived teachers/students, and fixed Level 5 boundaries.
Full prompts, seeds, model revisions, hardware, GPU hours, retained indices, decontamination checks, and generated-data terms are undisclosed.
The official checklist marks computational-budget and infrastructure reporting as complete, but the 11-page paper does not identify hardware or GPU hours.
Math-Verify 接受确立最终答案正确性，但不确立中间步骤有效性、忠实性或事后合理化的缺失。
要求全部四种条件成功会移除 1,055 道题，并可能选出在教师模型行为上异常容易或稳健的提示。
NoRethink 与 NoThink 是提示/解码干预，而非内部推理机制的经核验分离。
仅描述成功入选的解答；失败尝试、拒绝原因与反事实轨迹未发布。
该课程依赖于 MATH 的五个难度标签、英语数学任务、Qwen 衍生的教师模型/学生模型，以及固定的 Level 5 边界。
完整提示、种子、模型修订、硬件、GPU 小时、保留索引、去污染检查与生成数据条款未披露。
官方清单将计算预算与基础设施报告标为完整，但 11 页论文未标明硬件或 GPU 小时。
